depiction.primary_object: horizontal telephone handset with earpieces pointing downward
depiction.composition: single horizontal object, side view, arched upward

readings.meaning: end call / hang up / disconnect phone
cancel phone service or landline contract

ambiguity: Often confused with a general phone call icon, though the horizontal downward-facing orientation specifically denotes hanging up or disconnecting rather than making a call; at very small sizes it can also resemble a drawer handle or game controller.

reasoning: The downward-facing horizontal handset is the universal UI symbol for hanging up or ending a phone call. In a to-do app it specifically fits disconnecting/canceling phone lines or call-handling tasks, and secondarily serves as a general telephone icon, though an angled handset is standard for outgoing calls.
